text: Handling deadlines well depends on good planning and clear communication. First, time management is essential: create a realistic schedule, break large tasks into smaller steps, and start early instead of waiting until the last minute. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important tasks first, so urgent work never gets ignored. Third, scope management means being honest about how much you can realistically complete, and reducing the work if necessary rather than missing the deadline. Finally, communication matters: if a problem appears, tell your team or manager immediately instead of hiding it. Together, these habits reduce stress and help you deliver good work on time.
